subject: I wasn't going to send this secret feature preview
preview_text: You're getting an exclusive first look at what's coming next. This changes how you'll hear everything.
body_paragraphs: Okay, I'm breaking protocol. The dev team told me not to share this yet, but I can't keep it from our most loyal users. We've been working on something in secret for months, and it's almost ready.

You know that feeling when you're listening to a live concert recording and you wish you could feel the crowd's energy? Or when a podcast host whispers a crucial detail and you strain to hear it? We're about to solve that permanently. This isn't just another EQ preset.

We're calling it 'Spatial Soundstage.' It's a complete audio remapping that makes your phone speakers feel like a 3D sound system. It doesn't just boost volume—it places instruments and voices in physical space around you. Bass comes from below, vocals hover in front, and ambient sounds wrap around your head. You'll hear details in your favorite tracks you never knew existed.

The beta is locked down tight, but as an existing user, you'll get first access when it drops next month. For now, open the app and play with the 'Electronic' preset on the EQ. That's the closest preview you'll get of the new tech. P.S. Don't share this email. Seriously. The team will kill me if this leaks before launch.
